##  1. STEPS FOR ONLINE APPLICATION
  1. **Non-citizens of India** should only use this form **(i.e. Form No. 95 / Form No. 96)** for submitting application for allotment of PAN. However, a **Qualified Foreign Investor (QFI) has to apply for PAN in Form No. 95 / Form No. 96 through a Depository Participant only.**
  2. Applicant will initially register by selecting Form No. 95 / Form No. 96 along with category and title of the applicant and enter the required details and submit. A token number will be generated and displayed to the applicant before filling the form. This token number would also be sent on e-mail ID (provided in the application) for reference purpose. There is a facility to save the details entered in the application form such that this data can be viewed by the applicant prior to its final submission by using this temporary token number.
  3. If the data submitted fails in any format level validation, a response indicating the error(s) will be displayed on the screen. 
  4. The applicant shall rectify the error(s) and re-submit the form. 
  5. If there are no format level error(s), a confirmation screen with data filled by the applicant will be displayed. 
  6. The applicant may either edit or confirm the same.
